read_only_fault_injection.name: Existing workflow contract accepts omitted browser execution
read_only_fault_injection.mechanism: Read original file, mutate string only in memory, mock pathlib.Path.read_text while running existing PullRequestWorkflowTests. No disk/source/workflow edits.

replay.python_code:
import sys, unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path.insert(0, 'tests')
import test_ci_gate
original = Path('.github/workflows/pr-gate.yml').read_text('utf-8')
mutated = original.replace('run: npm run test:browser', 'run: echo browser checks omitted')
assert mutated != original
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(test_ci_gate.PullRequestWorkflowTests)
with patch.object(Path, 'read_text', return_value=mutated):
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
print('IN_MEMORY_ONLY browser run removed; existing workflow contract accepts:', result.wasSuccessful())
raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())

read_only_fault_injection.interpretation: Current workflow does execute browser checks. The existing workflow regression contract would not catch replacing that browser run step with echo; aggregator only sees successful job status.

interpretation_limits: A coverage gap is not proof of a current product bug.
Passing current creation-time tests does not validate a newly defined submission-time requirement.
No current browser/Node failure was observed in the reported successful runs.
No test was weakened, product changed, production rerun or commit created by this auditor.
